cohort: A community-based cohort of 378 children (336 appropriate for gestational age and 42 small for gestational age) with a median gestational age of 35 weeks (range 31-41).
finding: Children born small for gestational age (SGA) had a greater risk of abnormal test scores on attention control compared to children born appropriate for gestational age (AGA), independent of gestational age, while their motor and other cognitive functions were largely similar.
birth_weight: Defined by birth weight z-score (< -1 SD for SGA, >= -1 SD for AGA)
